items.summary: Update the Admin Users screen so an admin ALWAYS sees the full list of users (approved + unapproved) in the existing /admin/users screen (do not create a new admin screen), while preserving the current Admin layout and actions menu structure.

Ensure that on the Admin Users list view, user details remain permanently visible in the list row (not only inside a dialog): photo, name, email, phone number, and signup date/time (from users.createdAt) must be visible for every user in the list (role-based hiding is not allowed for these fields).

Keep Admin actions functional at all times on /admin/users for every user: approve, block, delete, and make helper admin (promote) must work without breaking the list UI or requiring a page refresh; the list must update after each action.

Enforce the exact Chat Request UI logic on the approved users list: (1) any user can send a chat request to another approved user; (2) the sender must ONLY see “Request Sent” after sending; (3) the receiver must see Accept/Reject ONLY when request.toUserId === currentUserId AND request.status === "pending".

After a receiver Accepts a pending chat request, open a permanent private 1-to-1 chat room between the two users and display a standard chat UI with message list + chat input; the chat must remain accessible in the future (not a temporary session).

After a receiver Rejects a pending chat request: (1) the sender must clearly see that the request was rejected; (2) the sender can re-send a request to the same receiver ONLY after 24 hours have passed since the rejection.

Ensure changes are verifiably visible in Draft: after implementing each missing piece above, update the relevant screens so that the behavior change can be confirmed immediately in the Draft preview without requiring undocumented steps.
